kjv: the kings that [were] on the north of the mountains
mine: the kings who were in the north, in the hill country
note: Mitsafon bahar lists regions: "from the north, in the hill country", not a location north of the mountains.
'Iqqer is to cut the hamstring tendons, crippling the horses; "hough" is an obsolete word for this that few readers now know.

kjv: the cities that stood still in their strength
mine: the cities that stood on their mounds
note: 'Al-tillam means "on their tell", the mound of earlier occupation layers on which a city stood; KJV takes tel as "strength", missing the archaeological sense.
